name: Salmon Mason Jar "Grain Bowl" with Brown Rice, Cabbage, Radish, Cucumber & Sesame Ginger Dressing (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup brown rice
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 45-50 minutes. Once done, remove rice from heat and spread it out on a baking sheet pan to cool, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
½ bunch radish
½ English cucumber

instructions.primary_message: Peel and roughly chop ginger. Peel garlic. Place both in a blender.
Add oil, vinegar, miso paste, maple syrup, and cayenne pepper to the blender. Blend on high until smooth, then divide dressing between two (quart-sized) jars.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp miso paste, white
2 tsp pure maple syrup
⅛ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add shredded cabbage to the jars with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (14 oz) bag shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve radishes, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the jars.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the jars.
Drain salmon, flake with a fork, and add to the jars.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (7.5 oz) can wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.primary_message: When the rice is cool, add to the jars, packing lightly if necessary.
Screw lids onto jars and store in the fridge until needed. (Best if used within 2-3 days.)
When ready to eat, empty jar into a bowl (making sure to scrape out all of the dressing!), then stir to combine the grain bowl. Enjoy!
